commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.

90+8' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
90+6' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by David Soria.
